{{Hatnote|For the 2025 event, see [[2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase]].}}
'''2026 Scrapyard Scrum''' was an eight-player [[Scavenger Format]] triple-elimination tournament on [[GEMP]] in March and April 2026. It was the second Scavenger Superbowl Showcase. [[AceMace]] won, defeating [[Matthew Ford]] 2–0 in the Final Confrontation on 31 March – 2 April 2026.<ref name="ss26">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86297 Scrapyard Scrum 2026], Domestique, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 December 2025; standings 2 April 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017125346/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86297.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Scavenger Format]]
* '''Platform:''' GEMP
* '''Tournament organizer:''' [[Domestique]]<ref name="ss26" />
* '''Dates:''' March–April 2026<ref name="ss26" />
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86297 Scrapyard Scrum 2026 thread]

Players were invited by cumulative GEMP points in the 2025 monthly Scavenger leagues.<ref name="ss26" /> Each player played four Preliminary games, two Dark Side and two Light Side. Three losses after the Prelims eliminated a player. Remaining players continued in Advanced Rounds until two remained. Those two played the Final Confrontation until one player had three tournament losses.<ref name="ss26" />

[[AceMace]] received a bye in Advanced 6. [[Matthew Ford|WormTime]] received a bye in Advanced 5.<ref name="ss26" />
